note: Re-judged 2026-10-18 (independent auditor, after a78870fd39). RFC 5798 Section 5.2.6 says "This field MUST be set to zero on transmission and ignored on reception." TestEncodeGoldenV3IPv4 now runs a subtest per checksum mode, and each still requires the rsvd nibble to be zero and the exact golden bytes; TestEncodeV3ReserveZeroOverDirtyBuffer encodes over an all-0xFF buffer against the default-mode golden G2. The reception half is TestDecodeV3ReserveIgnoredOnReceive, unchanged. Verdict unchanged.
